title: Size each bucket's burst from its plan
author: agent
done: That's a review in merl. Every key works now: o opens a file, s searches, t hides the panel, ? lists the rest. On your own branch, run merl --review.

steps.ask: This is an agent's branch. merl opens it on the first change: red lines are gone, green ones are new. Press <kbd>c</kbd> for the next change.
steps.say: The bucket now takes its burst from the plan.

steps.ask: The new code calls {fn}. Put the cursor on it: /, type {fn}, Enter. Then d opens it.
steps.say: <kbd>d</kbd> went to the definition, in a file this branch adds.
<kbd>u</kbd> lists every use: only the bucket calls it.

steps.ask: Press <kbd>Esc</kbd>, then <kbd>[</kbd> to go back to the review.
steps.say: <kbd>[</kbd> went back. Every jump is remembered.

steps.ask: Walk on with <kbd>c</kbd> until merl shows a renamed file. Each file you pass gets a tick in the panel.
steps.say: {old} became {new} and nothing else changed, so merl shows the move, not the file.

steps.ask: Press <kbd>c</kbd> on to the end of the review.
steps.say: Every file has a tick. That's the whole review.
